note: Characters. Stories reference them by id; options pick the variant.

characters.api: ZCharacters.kid({ variant }) → { group, setExpression, play, setTalk, hold(prop, 'R'|'L'), update(dt) }

characters.role: everyone else: the cast is one adjustable body plus a wardrobe
rules: No school uniforms (the user's choice): everyday clothes only
Every t-shirt and hoodie carries the Zungga mascot (assets/brand/zungga-mascot.png)
characters.api: ZCharacters.person({ height, weight, build, age, sex, hair, hairColor, skin, mustache, wear: { top, layer, bottom, shoes, tie, dupatta, eyewear } }) → same API as kid

characters.role: cartoon cast (plush look, consistent across videos)

kinds.cat: Yellow cat: round body, blue belly, blue-tipped ears, tuft, ball tail
kinds.boxkid: Box kid: purple box head, cream face, orange cap + overalls (pencil, wrench)
kinds.planet: Planet buddy: glowing pink-purple planet with a ring, bubble antenna, floating bubbles

characters.api: ZCharacters.toon({ kind, colors }) → same API as person; in story.json cast use { "toon": "cat" }
characters.world: Box-folk (kind 'folk'): everyone shares the hero's box-head design with different heights, outfits, hats, hair and colours
